_doc: Babylon 5's commands from the comms menu (M8-T34): how near the player covering fire reaches, how far the sitrep counts raiders, and what Control answers. {WING}, {WINGS}, {SECTIONS}, {RAIDERS}, {KM} and {GRID} are filled in.

lines.launch: {WING} WING, CLEARED TO LAUNCH. GOOD HUNTING
lines.launch_bay: {WING} WING IS IN THE BAY, LAUNCHING NOW
lines.launch_none: NEGATIVE, EVERY WING IS ALREADY OUT
lines.recall: ALL FIGHTERS, RETURN TO BABYLON 5 AND DOCK
lines.grid_off: DEFENSE GRID OFFLINE, HOLDING ALL FIRE
lines.support_on: COPY, COVERING FIRE ON YOUR POSITION
lines.support_grid_off: NEGATIVE, THE DEFENSE GRID IS OFFLINE
lines.shelter_on: ALL CIVILIAN TRAFFIC, HOLD. TAKE SHELTER INSIDE OR BEHIND THE STATION
lines.shelter_off: CIVILIAN TRAFFIC, YOU ARE CLEARED TO RESUME
